content: ईश {%a.%} [ईश्-क] .²1 Owning, possessing, sharing, master or lord of; see below. .²2 One who is completely master of anything. .²3 Capable of (with <ab>gen.</ab>) .²4 Powerful, supreme. .{@-शः@} .²1 A lord, master; with <ab>gen.</ab> or in <ab>comp.</ab>; कथंचिदीशा मनसां बभूवुः <ls>Ku. 3. 34</ls> with great difficulty controlled (were masters of) their minds; so वागीश, सुरेश <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 A husband. .²3 A Rudra. .²4 The number 11 (derived from the eleven Rudras). .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva (as regent of the north-east quarter). .²6 The Supreme god (परमेश्वर); व्यक्ताव्यक्तं भरते विश्वमीशमीड्यम् <ls>Śvet. Up. 1. 8</ls>; प्रसादये त्वामहमीशमीड्यम् <ls>Bg. 11. 44</ls>. श्रीवत्सधामापररात्र ईशः <ls>Bhāg. 6. 8. 22</ls>. .{@-शा@} .²1 Supremacy, power, dominion, greatness. <ls>Śvet. Up. 4. 7</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā. .²3 A woman having supremacy; a rich lady.
